svg.text: Orca hosts and hub, round 2 mockup (dark)
Approved layouts: picker B (one list, host tag per row), chip A (host prefix), settings A (Hub pane), banner A. Sample hosts: local (the hub), laptop (online), desktop (offline, seen 2h ago).
D1 Send to, sessions on two hosts
Host tag only for non-local hosts. Offline host sessions are not listed; one note says so.

g.text: One prompt with every ticked finding. Human threads are left out.
desktop is offline (seen 2h ago), so its sessions are not listed.
Your choice is remembered for this PR.

svg.text: D2 New worktree picked, host menu open
Menu lists online hosts first, offline greyed with last seen. Picking a host stores it per repo.
The repo's host is offline: the row falls back to local and says so. Nothing is queued.

g.text: This repo usually runs on desktop, which is offline (seen 2h ago).

svg.text: C1 Session chip on a PR row (host prefix)
Local sessions show no host, exactly as today. Offline: dashed ring, muted, last seen.

g.text: Support sensor type 14 and fix cancel recursion
not clickable to send; Open shows the last state

svg.text: Same list; tag sits right of the name; host select is a full-width row.
New nav item under GitHub. Per-repo host rows list repos seen in the inbox.

g.text: An always-on Nod this desktop uses instead of its own server. Empty keeps everything here.
Shown until this desktop is paired.
Where a new worktree runs when you do not pick one.
Saved on the hub. Admin desktops only.

svg.text: B1 Hub unreachable (top of the 1660 window, shown at 880)
Attention banner under the top bar, full width, until the hub answers. Chip agrees.

g.text: Seen marks are kept here and sent when the hub is back.
Back on the hub. 12 seen marks sent.
